title: Next steps
purpose: Close with a credible production path and invite discussion.
takeaway: The next phase should strengthen human evaluation, serving parity, and measured rewrite quality before expanding optimization scope.

bullets: Establish human-reviewed extraction and rewrite quality gates.
Resolve scorer training-serving context drift and calibrate reviewer-facing outputs.
Freeze a separate P2 evaluation set before prompt or optimizer work.
Add persistence, source-style preview, and HTML patching only after the review contract stabilizes.

speaker_notes: End with the question: where would this workflow create the most value inside Profound?
